en.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

zhSimplified.text: 提幔人以利法回答说：

zhTraditional.text: 提幔人以利法回答說：

en.text: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?

zhSimplified.text: 智慧人岂可用虚空的知识回答， 用东风充满肚腹呢？

zhTraditional.text: 智慧人豈可用虛空的知識回答， 用東風充滿肚腹呢？

en.text: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?

zhSimplified.text: 他岂可用无益的话 和无济于事的言语理论呢？

zhTraditional.text: 他豈可用無益的話 和無濟於事的言語理論呢？

en.text: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.

zhSimplified.text: 你是废弃敬畏的意， 在 神面前阻止敬虔的心。

zhTraditional.text: 你是廢棄敬畏的意， 在上帝面前阻止敬虔的心。

en.text: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.

zhSimplified.text: 你的罪孽指教你的口； 你选用诡诈人的舌头。

zhTraditional.text: 你的罪孽指教你的口； 你選用詭詐人的舌頭。

en.text: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.

zhSimplified.text: 你自己的口定你有罪，并非是我； 你自己的嘴见证你的不是。

zhTraditional.text: 你自己的口定你有罪，並非是我； 你自己的嘴見證你的不是。

en.text: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?

zhSimplified.text: 你岂是头一个被生的人吗？ 你受造在诸山之先吗？

zhTraditional.text: 你豈是頭一個被生的人嗎？ 你受造在諸山之先嗎？

en.text: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

zhSimplified.text: 你曾听见 神的密旨吗？ 你还将智慧独自得尽吗？

zhTraditional.text: 你曾聽見上帝的密旨嗎？ 你還將智慧獨自得盡嗎？

en.text: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?

zhSimplified.text: 你知道什么是我们不知道的呢？ 你明白什么是我们不明白的呢？

zhTraditional.text: 你知道甚麼是我們不知道的呢？ 你明白甚麼是我們不明白的呢？

en.text: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.

zhSimplified.text: 我们这里有白发的和年纪老迈的， 比你父亲还老。

zhTraditional.text: 我們這裏有白髮的和年紀老邁的， 比你父親還老。

en.text: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?

zhSimplified.text: 神用温和的话安慰你， 你以为太小吗？

zhTraditional.text: 上帝用溫和的話安慰你， 你以為太小嗎？

en.text: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,

zhSimplified.text: 你的心为何将你逼去？ 你的眼为何冒出火星，

zhTraditional.text: 你的心為何將你逼去？ 你的眼為何冒出火星，

en.text: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?

zhSimplified.text: 使你的灵反对 神， 也任你的口发这言语？

zhTraditional.text: 使你的靈反對上帝， 也任你的口發這言語？

en.text: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

zhSimplified.text: 人是什么，竟算为洁净呢？ 妇人所生的是什么，竟算为义呢？

zhTraditional.text: 人是甚麼，竟算為潔淨呢？ 婦人所生的是甚麼，竟算為義呢？

en.text: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;

zhSimplified.text: 神不信靠他的众圣者； 在他眼前，天也不洁净，

zhTraditional.text: 上帝不信靠他的眾聖者； 在他眼前，天也不潔淨，

en.text: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!

zhSimplified.text: 何况那污秽可憎、 喝罪孽如水的世人呢！

zhTraditional.text: 何況那污穢可憎、 喝罪孽如水的世人呢！

en.text: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare

zhSimplified.text: 我指示你，你要听； 我要述说所看见的，

zhTraditional.text: 我指示你，你要聽； 我要述說所看見的，

en.text: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;

zhSimplified.text: 就是智慧人从列祖所受， 传说而不隐瞒的。

zhTraditional.text: 就是智慧人從列祖所受， 傳說而不隱瞞的。 （

en.text: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):

zhSimplified.text: 这地惟独赐给他们， 并没有外人从他们中间经过。

zhTraditional.text: 這地惟獨賜給他們， 並沒有外人從他們中間經過。）

en.text: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人一生之日劬劳痛苦； 强暴人一生的年数也是如此。

zhTraditional.text: 惡人一生之日劬勞痛苦； 強暴人一生的年數也是如此。

en.text: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.

zhSimplified.text: 惊吓的声音常在他耳中； 在平安时，抢夺的必临到他那里。

zhTraditional.text: 驚嚇的聲音常在他耳中； 在平安時，搶奪的必臨到他那裏。

en.text: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.

zhSimplified.text: 他不信自己能从黑暗中转回； 他被刀剑等候。

zhTraditional.text: 他不信自己能從黑暗中轉回； 他被刀劍等候。

en.text: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

zhSimplified.text: 他漂流在外求食，说：哪里有食物呢？ 他知道黑暗的日子在他手边预备好了。

zhTraditional.text: 他漂流在外求食，說：哪裏有食物呢？ 他知道黑暗的日子在他手邊預備好了。

en.text: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

zhSimplified.text: 急难困苦叫他害怕， 而且胜了他，好像君王预备上阵一样。

zhTraditional.text: 急難困苦叫他害怕， 而且勝了他，好像君王預備上陣一樣。

en.text: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,

zhSimplified.text: 他伸手攻击 神， 以骄傲攻击全能者，

zhTraditional.text: 他伸手攻擊上帝， 以驕傲攻擊全能者，

en.text: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,

zhSimplified.text: 挺着颈项， 用盾牌的厚凸面向全能者直闯；

zhTraditional.text: 挺着頸項， 用盾牌的厚凸面向全能者直闖；

en.text: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.

zhSimplified.text: 是因他的脸蒙上脂油， 腰积成肥肉。

zhTraditional.text: 是因他的臉蒙上脂油， 腰積成肥肉。

en.text: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.

zhSimplified.text: 他曾住在荒凉城邑， 无人居住、将成乱堆的房屋。

zhTraditional.text: 他曾住在荒涼城邑， 無人居住、將成亂堆的房屋。

en.text: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 他不得富足，财物不得常存， 产业在地上也不加增。

zhTraditional.text: 他不得富足，財物不得常存， 產業在地上也不加增。

en.text: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 他不得出离黑暗。 火焰要将他的枝子烧干； 因 神口中的气，他要灭亡 。

zhTraditional.text: 他不得出離黑暗。 火焰要將他的枝子燒乾； 因上帝口中的氣，他要滅亡。

en.text: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.

zhSimplified.text: 他不用倚靠虚假欺哄自己， 因虚假必成为他的报应。

zhTraditional.text: 他不用倚靠虛假欺哄自己， 因虛假必成為他的報應。

en.text: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.

zhSimplified.text: 他的日期未到之先，这事必成就； 他的枝子不得青绿。

zhTraditional.text: 他的日期未到之先，這事必成就； 他的枝子不得青綠。

en.text: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

zhSimplified.text: 他必像葡萄树的葡萄，未熟而落； 又像橄榄树的花，一开而谢。

zhTraditional.text: 他必像葡萄樹的葡萄，未熟而落； 又像橄欖樹的花，一開而謝。

en.text: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.

zhSimplified.text: 原来不敬虔之辈必无生育； 受贿赂之人的帐棚必被火烧。

zhTraditional.text: 原來不敬虔之輩必無生育； 受賄賂之人的帳棚必被火燒。

en.text: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们所怀的是毒害，所生的是罪孽； 心里所预备的是诡诈。

zhTraditional.text: 他們所懷的是毒害，所生的是罪孽； 心裏所預備的是詭詐。
